```{r}
check_correlations <- function(mat){
  mat_corr <- cor(mat)
  mat_corr_diag <- mat_corr[lower.tri(mat_corr)]
  print(paste("Maximum correlation in the matrix:", round(max(mat_corr_diag),3)))
  print(paste("Minimum correlation in the matrix:", round(min(mat_corr_diag),3)))
  pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_corr, show_rownames = F, show_colnames = F)
}
```

## 1.3 Metabolomics
```{r}
compound_names <- read.csv('metabolomics/compound_names.csv') %>% select(-X) %>% unique()
# manually adjust long compound names
compound_names$compound_name[compound_names$compound_name == "2-Methylglutaric acid/3-Methylglutaric acid"] <- "2|3-Methylglutaric acid" 
compound_map <- compound_names$compound_name
names(compound_map) <- compound_names$compound_id

# remove drug metabolites
drug_metabolites <- c("Vinorelbine", "Simvastatin acid", "Acetylsalicylic acid", "Salicylic acid",
                      "Bestatin", "Trichostatin A", "Vincamine", "Castanospermine",
                      "Allopurinol", "4-Acetamidophenol", "4-Aminophenol")
drug_metabolites_to_remove <- grep(paste(drug_metabolites, collapse = "|"), compound_names$compound_name, value = T, ignore.case = F)
drug_ids_to_remove <- compound_names %>% filter(compound_name %in% drug_metabolites_to_remove) %>% pull(compound_id)
```

```{r}
met_df <-  read.csv('metabolomics/transformed_df.csv', check.names = T) %>% rename(sample_id = "case_number") %>% 
            mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id)) %>% 
           left_join(mdata %>% select(-is_fap), by = "sample_id") %>% 
           select(-sample_id) %>% filter(!is.na(patient_id)) %>% select(-drug_ids_to_remove)

colnames(met_df) <- c(paste0("M__", colnames(met_df)[1:ncol(met_df)-1]), "patient_id")
```

```{r}
regressors <- c("bmi", "age", "gender")

ggdata_all <- data.frame()
```

```{r}
combined<- met_df %>% inner_join(taxa_df , by = "patient_id") %>%  inner_join(blood_df, by = "patient_id")
data_to_label <- list("Metabolomics" = met_df, 
                      "Taxonomy" = taxa_df %>% filter(patient_id %in% met_df$patient_id),
```

## 2.1 Logistic regression
```{r}
roc_df_all <- data.frame()
feature_df_all <- data.frame()

for (label in names(data_to_label)){
  data <- data_to_label[[label]] %>% left_join(mdata_logit, by = "patient_id")
  r <- run_glm_prediction(data %>% select(-patient_id, -is_fap), as.numeric(data$is_fap),
                        n_shuffles = 0,n_repeats = 10, seed = 41, alpha = 0.5, scale_features = T)
  
  mean_auc <- r$auc_df$mean_auc
  sd_auc <- r$auc_df$sd_auc
  roc_df <- r$roc_df %>% mutate(auc = paste0("(AUC ",round(mean_auc,2), "±", round(sd_auc,2), ")", sep = ""),
                                label = label, label_auc = paste(label, auc))
  feature_df <- r$feature_importance_df %>% filter(abs(mean_coef) > sd_coef) %>% mutate(label = label)
  roc_df_all <- rbind(roc_df_all, roc_df)
  feature_df_all <- rbind(feature_df_all, feature_df)
}
```

# 3. MintTea
## 3.1 Helper functions for calculating feature correlations
```{r}
# Helper to tidy rcorr output for one method
tidy_rcorr <- function(mat, method) {
  rc <- Hmisc::rcorr(as.matrix(mat), type = method)   # r and P matrices
  r  <- rc$r
  p  <- rc$P
  # keep upper triangle without diagonal
  keep <- upper.tri(r, diag = FALSE)
  tibble(
    feature.x = rownames(r)[row(r)][keep],
    feature.y = colnames(r)[col(r)][keep],
    r         = r[keep],
    p         = p[keep],
    method    = method
  )
}

to_superscript_letter <- function(x) {
  map <- c("A"="ᴬ","B"="ᴮ","G"="ᴳ")
  sapply(strsplit(x, ","), function(letters) {
    converted <- map[letters]
    converted[is.na(converted)] <- letters   # fallback for unmapped letters
    paste0(converted, collapse = "")
  })
}

remove_superscript <- function(x) {
  map <- c("A"="ᴬ","B"="ᴮ","G"="ᴳ")
  pattern <- paste0("[", paste0(unname(map), collapse = ""), "]")
  gsub(pattern, "", x)
}
```

## 3.2 Run MintTea on the original data
```{r}
data <-  combined %>% left_join(mdata_logit, by = "patient_id")  %>% select(-all_of(regressors)) %>%  
        mutate(is_fap = ifelse(is_fap, "FAP", "Control"))

data <-  combined %>% left_join(mdata_logit, by = "patient_id") %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>% 
        get_residuals(., regressors) %>%
        select(-all_of(regressors)) %>%
        mutate(is_fap = ifelse(is_fap, "FAP", "Control")) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("patient_id")

minttea_results <- MintTea(data,
                           view_prefixes = c('T', 'M', 'B'),
                           study_group_column = "is_fap",
                           control_group_name = "Control",
                           case_group_name = "FAP",
                           sample_id_column = "patient_id",
                           seed = 41)
```
## 3.3 Extract the network of the largest module
```{r}
prefix_mapping <- c("T" = "Genus", "M" = "Metabolite", "B" = "Blood Test")
feature_map <- c(blood_map,compound_map)

module <- minttea_results$`keep_10//des_0.5//nrep_10//nfol_5//ncom_5//edge_0.8`$module1
module_features <- c(module$module_edge$feature.x, module$module_edges$feature.y) %>% unique()
feature_enrichment_group <- data %>% select( is_fap, module_features) %>% 
                            tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = module_features, names_to = "feature") %>% 
                            group_by(feature, is_fap) %>% summarise(value = mean(value)) %>% 
                            group_by(feature) %>% filter(value == max(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>%
                            select(-value) %>% rename(raw = 1, enrichment_direction = 2)
```


## 3.4 Find significant correlations between module features 
```{r}
cor_df <- data %>%
  select(all_of(c("patient_id", module$features))) %>%
  left_join(mdata_logit %>% select(c("patient_id"), regressors ), by = "patient_id") %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>% tidy_rcorr(., "spearman") %>% 
  filter(!feature.x %in% regressors, feature.y %in% regressors) %>%
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) 

flag_features <- cor_df %>% filter(fdr < 0.05) %>%
                 mutate(pref = toupper(substr(feature.y, start = 1, stop = 1))) %>% 
                 group_by(feature.x) %>% 
                 summarise(superscript = to_superscript_letter(paste(pref, collapse = ",")))
```

```{r}
cor_df <- data %>%
  select(all_of(c("patient_id", module$features))) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_id") %>% tidy_rcorr(., "spearman") %>% 
  mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>% mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  filter(abs(r) > 0.3, fdr < 0.05)
```

## 3.5 construct a module graph
```{r}
df <- module$module_edge %>% 
  inner_join(cor_df, by = c("feature.x", "feature.y")) %>% 
  left_join(flag_features, by = "feature.x") %>% 
  left_join(flag_features, by = c("feature.y" = "feature.x")) %>% 
  mutate(across(starts_with("superscript"), ~replace_na(., ""))) %>% 
  mutate(feature_x = feature.x, feature_y = feature.y) %>% 
  tidyr::separate(feature.x, into = c("prefix.x", "feature.x"), sep = "__", extra = "merge") %>% 
  tidyr::separate(feature.y, into = c("prefix.y", "feature.y"), sep = "__", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(feature_1 = ifelse(prefix.x == "T", feature.x, feature_map[feature.x]),
         feature_2 = ifelse(prefix.y == "T", feature.y, feature_map[feature.y]),
         feature_1 = gsub("/","\n", feature_1),
         feature_2 = gsub("/","\n", feature_2),
         feature_1 = paste0(feature_1, superscript.x),
         feature_2 = paste0(feature_2, superscript.y))

edges <- df %>% select(feature_1, feature_2, edge_weight, r)
nodes <- rbind(df %>% select(feature_1, prefix.x,feature_x) %>% rename(name = feature_1, Omic = prefix.x, raw = feature_x),
               df %>% select(feature_2, prefix.y, feature_y) %>% rename(name = feature_2, Omic = prefix.y, raw = feature_y)) %>% unique() %>% 
         left_join(feature_enrichment_group, by = "raw") %>% 
         mutate(omic = prefix_mapping[Omic])
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}

g <- tidygraph::tbl_graph(edges = edges, nodes = nodes, directed = F) %>%
  activate(edges) %>% mutate(distance = 1 / edge_weight)
layout <- create_layout(g, layout = 'igraph', algorithm = 'nicely')
layout <- create_layout(g, layout = "stress", weights = distance)
p1 <-ggraph(layout) + 
    geom_edge_fan(aes(color = r),  width = 2, position = "jitter", label_dodge = T) +
  
    scale_edge_color_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "#eff7f6", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "R") +
    geom_node_point(aes(shape = omic, fill = enrichment_direction), size = 6, alpha = 0.9) + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Metabolite" = 24, "Genus" = 21, "Blood Test" = 22)) + 
    geom_node_label(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 4, check_overlap = T, force = 100,  segment.color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette) + scale_color_manual(values = palette) + 
    labs(edge_color = "R", shape = "Omic", fill = "Enrichment direction") + 
    theme_void() + #theme(legend.position = 'top') + 
    theme(legend.text=element_text(size=11), legend.title = element_text(size=12))
p1
```

```{r}
id_cols <- c("feature_name", "feature", "feature_type")
maaslin_features <- read.csv("figures/f1/f1_feature_lists.csv") %>% select(3,1,4,2)
metabolomic_features <- read.csv("figures/f2/f2_feature_lists.csv")
multi_omic_features <- read.csv("figures/f3/f3_feature_lists_residuals.csv")
df <- maaslin_features %>%  full_join(metabolomic_features, by = id_cols) %>% 
      full_join(multi_omic_features, by = id_cols)
df$n_models <- rowSums(!is.na(df)) - length(id_cols)
df$max_models <- ifelse(df$feature_type == "Blood Test", 3, 4)
df$perc_models <- df$n_models/df$max_models
colnames(df) <- c("feature_name", "feature", "feature_type","F1","F2",
                  "F3_metabolomics", "F3_taxonomy",
                  "F3_blood", "F3_combined", "F3_minttea", 
                  "n_models", "max_models", "perc_models")
#write.csv(df, "figures/complete_feature_lists_v2.csv",  row.names = F)
```
